name: glyphkiln
description: Glyphkiln's deterministic rendering engine and self-hostable application.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @glyphkiln/core && npm run dev --workspace @glyphkiln/app
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @glyphkiln/core && npm run build --workspace @glyphkiln/app
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @glyphkiln/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @glyphkiln/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @glyphkiln/app && npm run typecheck --workspace @glyphkiln/example-style-showcase
scripts.lint: npm run build --workspace @glyphkiln/core && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && prettier --check .
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @glyphkiln/core && npm run test --workspace @glyphkiln/app && npm run test --workspace @glyphkiln/example-style-showcase
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build --workspace @glyphkiln/core && npm run test:coverage --workspace @glyphkiln/core && npm run test:coverage --workspace @glyphkiln/app && npm run test:coverage --workspace @glyphkiln/example-style-showcase
scripts.examples:generate: npm run build --workspace @glyphkiln/core && npm run examples:generate --workspace @glyphkiln/core && npm run render --workspace @glyphkiln/example-style-showcase
scripts.examples:verify: npm run build --workspace @glyphkiln/core && npm run examples:verify --workspace @glyphkiln/core && npm run verify --workspace @glyphkiln/example-style-showcase
